categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Qingyi Photomask Limited primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of photomasks (also known as photolithography masks). Its products serve key industries including flat panel displays, semiconductor chips, touch panels, and printed circuit boards. The company operates through multiple subsidiaries focusing on photomask manufacturing and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on advanced photolithography technologies including laser direct writing and electron beam writing for photomask production. It has developed proprietary core process technologies such as high-precision CD measurement, HTM (halftone mask), PSM (phase shift mask), and OPC (optical proximity correction). The manufacturing process involves high-precision equipment like photolithography machines, laser repair machines, and automated inspection systems, supported by in-house developed software for design and defect detection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading flat panel display manufacturers such as BOE, Visionox, HKC, Tianma, CSOT, and semiconductor companies like Chiplet Integrated, CRRC Times, BYD Semiconductor, Sanan Optoelectronics, and Changjiang Electronics. The company serves markets in flat panel displays (TFT-LCD, AMOLED, LTPS, LTPO), semiconductor chips (IC bumping, foundry, substrate, LED packaging, MEMS), touch panels, and flexible circuits.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Hefei, and Foshan. It serves domestic customers extensively and exports to regions including Taiwan and Singapore. Its supply chain involves international suppliers mainly from Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan for raw materials and equipment.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Qingyi Photomask Limited operates upstream in the electronic components manufacturing supply chain, producing photomasks which are critical high-precision tools used in downstream manufacturing of flat panel displays, semiconductors, touch panels, and circuit boards.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes independent R&D and technological innovation, focusing on developing high-precision photomasks for advanced display and semiconductor technologies. Key R&D directions include high-specification halftone masks (HTM), phase shift masks (PSM), and photomasks for semiconductor nodes from 180nm down to 28nm. It also invests in smart manufacturing, equipment development, and expanding production capacity to support domestic substitution and global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized photomask products to industrial clients. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also receives government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks as the largest domestic photomask manufacturer in China and is among the top five globally in flat panel display photomask sales. Major international competitors include companies like Photronics (USA), SKE, HOYA, DNP (Japan), and LG-IT (South Korea). Qingyi holds a leading position domestically, especially in mid-to-high-end photomask products, and is advancing in semiconductor photomask technology to compete internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.11 billion, a 20.35% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders growing 28.49% to RMB 172 million. Total assets grew by 32.07% to RMB 2.74 billion, reflecting investments in new production facilities. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding capacity and product upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingyi Photomask emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product precision, and comprehensive product portfolio covering various photomask types for flat panel displays and semiconductors. Its localized production bases near major customers enable faster delivery and responsive service. The company also highlights its role in breaking foreign monopolies by promoting domestic substitution of high-end photomasks, supported by continuous innovation and quality assurance.
